stretch.definition: Tier 1 echo(t) ~ Tier 0 echo of the same posts at t (1 + eps_measured) (the medium's stretch); ranges scaled by 1 + eps_applied; timing residual = (1 + eps_measured) / (1 + eps_applied) - 1; refit after each Tier 1 run

design_study_tier0.what: Tier 0 design study, stage 3 (100 ms notes); 2D for losses/judges/levels, 3D for level
design_study_tier0.selection: K chosen by the Tier 0 spectrogram loss (window_loss) on the FULL clap band under 2 mm radial jitter (seed 11); the note judge (notes in order, cents) is recorded for information and never used to choose; extinction estimate and per-note levels are physics, reported to explain the fill choice
design_study_tier0.extinction_model: two-way coherent loss ~ 8.686 * sum_j sigma_tot / (2 r_j tan(half-angle)) dB over posts nearer than the note (sigma_tot 2D rigid cylinder at 1.3 kHz); an estimate

strip_density_tier0.what: Tier 0 quick density check (strip +-1 m, 1 cm, K=1); judge info only

wedge_density_tier0.what: Tier 0 wedge/density study (100 ms): denser fills at +-1 deg, sparse fills at the spec's +-20 deg; profile = the solve's analytic initial profile (steps=0); no extinction pre-compensation
wedge_density_tier0.selection: none (explanatory); judge recorded for information only

design_study_tier0_wedge1deg_2cm.what: Tier 0 design study, stage 3 (100 ms notes); 2D for losses/judges/levels, 3D for level
design_study_tier0_wedge1deg_2cm.selection: candidates compared by the Tier 0 spectrogram loss (window_loss) in the Tier 1 band (clap band capped at f_max 2 kHz); the note judge (notes in order, cents) is recorded for information and never used to choose; extinction estimate and per-note levels are physics, reported to explain the fill choice
design_study_tier0_wedge1deg_2cm.extinction_model: two-way coherent loss ~ 8.686 * sum_j sigma_tot / (2 r_j tan(half-angle)) dB over posts nearer than the note (sigma_tot 2D rigid cylinder at 1.3 kHz); an estimate

fullwedge_tier0.what: Tier 0 ONLY (unverified): 100 ms melody in the full +-20 deg wedge, 1 cm posts, full clap band
fullwedge_tier0.selection: lowest full-band 2D window_loss under 2 mm radial jitter (seed 11); judges informational

rows.label: full wedge fill=0.20% phase_locked K=2 (added after the study)

fullwedge_tier0.note: row 5 (0.2 % K=2) added after the first pick to test the harmonic lever; the pick is re-made by the same rule

note_length_sweep.what: TIER 0 ONLY note-length sweep (not a Tier 1 result): shortest note length whose realized Tier 0 echo still transcribes for every clap (notes_in_order = 1.0 mean over claps), and the judge on the physically perfect echo (the judge's own floor) at each length
note_length_sweep.selection: none (a sweep; the judge is the quantity being measured, nothing is chosen by it)

level_along_melody.definition: per note: mean over claps of 20 log10(peak |echo|) in the note's window, re the direct clap at the listener; 3D corrected per note = L3d(Tier 0) + (L2d(Tier 1) - L2d(Tier 0)) of that note; SPL = 110.46 dB + level (100 dB peak at 1 m clap); 35 dB = likely inaudible

tier0_full_band.what: Tier 0 2D echo over the whole clap band 898-4000 Hz (what the 2 kHz Tier 1 referee cannot see: the clap's 2-4 kHz content and the comb's 2nd harmonics)

grid_and_domain.reason: Tier 1 budget (spec: <= 20 min per run; narrowed so one 100 ms run fits ~15 min on an idle machine); f_max from the top note G6 1568 Hz
grid_and_domain.invisible_to_tier1: clap content and comb harmonics above 2 kHz

robustness_not_run.status: not run (time/cost: the 100 ms run alone took ~30 min on the 2.5 kHz grid with the Tier 1 lock shared by three stages; free cases only)

diagnosis.what: recomputed from this run's scene.json and echo_tier1.wav (clap 0; per-clap Tier 1 echoes are not saved) and Tier 0 of the same posts for every clap; no new solve
diagnosis.residue_note: waveform residues are phase-sensitive: the design's ranges are pre-warped by the stretch compensation, so Tier 0 drifts against the unwarped perfect echo by ~0.2 % of the delay (a period or more late in the melody) and its residue reads ~0 dB; tonal_fraction_db is the phase-insensitive measure

tonal_fraction_db.definition: per note, power within +-3 % of the note frequency / total power, dB (0 = pure tone); phase-insensitive, so the stretch pre-warp does not affect it

extinction_table.model: 8.686 * sum over nearer posts of sigma_tot(f) / strip width (stage-1 calibrated: 7.4 dB predicted vs 7.2 dB measured)

level_two_ways.full_wedge_definition: Tier 0 3D per-note peak of the strip design + 20 log10(wedge width 2 rho tan 20 deg / strip width 2 m) at the note's mid range: ring populations scaled to the full wedge at the strip's areal density, coherent single scattering; not simulated
